query: How does resolution time vary by agent and issue type?

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: Directly realizes the 'issue type' axis of the query with well-separated, interpretable categories (email_server, network_connectivity, vpn, database_access, etc.) that resolution_time can be grouped and compared across.

per_column.name: assigned_agent
per_column.rationale: Directly realizes the 'agent' axis. Named agents form a clean, low-cardinality segmentation for comparing resolution_time across handlers.

per_column.name: severity_signal
per_column.rationale: An external associational dimension (outage, degradation, login_failure, server_crash) with interpretable, well-separated categories that plausibly influences resolution_time and enables meaningful segmentation beyond the query's stated axes.

per_column.name: technical_system_type
per_column.rationale: A coarser system grouping (network_vpn, email, database_sql, infrastructure) that offers an alternate, interpretable segmentation for resolution_time. Partially overlaps with issue_category but at a different granularity, still useful for exploration.

per_column.name: closing_agent_match
per_column.rationale: A clean binary (true/false) indicating whether the assigning agent also closed the ticket; a well-separated, interpretable flag that can be segmented against resolution_time (e.g., hand-offs vs. same-agent resolution).

judge.rationale: The set squarely serves the query: issue_category and assigned_agent instantiate the two explicit axes with clean, low-cardinality interpretable categories, while severity_signal, technical_system_type, and closing_agent_match add external associational dimensions each with well-separated, human-readable values that can be grouped against resolution_time. No column merely restates the focus, none is near-constant or opaquely scored. Minor redundancy exists between issue_category and technical_system_type (overlapping semantics at different granularity), which slightly lowers the informativeness of the set as independent relationships, but overall this strongly supports interpretable relationship discovery.
